messages:
alex: Deploybot queued schema-migration for accounts-service (add nullable column `last_seen_at`) — proposed change window 2026-03-25 02:00-03:00 UTC. Pin candidate: 3.8.1. Need ops + SRE signoff on backfill strategy and rollback criteria.

priya: I'll run preflight counts + replication checks now, ETA ~10m.

deploybot: Migration job created: migr-20260325-acc-135. Lease acquired on migration-slot-9. Available commands: `deploybot pin-version accounts-service 3.8.1`, `deploybot start-migration migr-20260325-acc-135` (manual start).

jorge: Backfill plan proposal — streaming backfill in small batches, throttle to ~200 rows/sec. Pause conditions: replica lag > 45s or primary CPU > 70%. We'll create a metric `backfill.rows/sec`.

maya: Rollback criteria suggestion: abort if >2% row transform errors OR if an index build fails. Also skip heavy indexes during this window (create offline later).

alex: Ops, can SRE reserve the maintenance slot and confirm monitoring hooks?

sre-oncall: Confirmed. Holding maintenance slot in the two-phase hatch. Watch thresholds: replica lag 60s (hard abort), tail p99 +50ms. Running preflight: `scripts/mig_preflight.sh migr-20260325-acc-135` before we start.

priya: Preflight checks in progress. Quick SQL: `SELECT count(*) FROM accounts WHERE last_seen_at IS NULL;` -> 1,234,567 rows. I'll calculate estimated runtime with the proposed throttle and post ETA.

ops-bot: Reminder: please add a short release-notes line to the release-notes draft in the repo before the deploy. Suggested snippet: `- accounts-service 3.8.1: add last_seen_at (nullable), streaming backfill`

alex: Pinning to 3.8.1 now: `deploybot pin-version accounts-service 3.8.1` :lock:

deploybot: Version pinned for accounts-service -> 3.8.1. Canary rollout scheduled at 02:00 UTC. Manual start required to begin migration.

jorge: Runtime knobs: `pg_copy_stream --batch_size=500 --sleep_ms=250`. We'll emit `backfill.rows/sec` and `backfill.errors` to the infra dashboard. If replica lag spikes, backfill auto-pauses.

maya: Operator escape hatch: `deploybot abort migr-20260325-acc-135` will stop the job and trigger the safe-downgrade path (schema remains compatible). Documented rollback steps in the runbook.

alex: Final checklist: preflight green, version pinned, SRE watching, release notes updated, ops aware. If no objections I'll hit manual start at slot.

priya: Preflight green. Posting estimated ETA: ~1h 45m at 200 rows/sec with occasional pauses. I'll remain on-call for the window. :thumbsup:

(threads: short updates only during window; use `@sre-oncall` for escalation)
